title: I built a free 3ds Max tool to transfer textures from AI-generated 3D models to clean retopo meshes (Before/After)
author: Mia_Oscar
selftext:
Hi everyone!

Like many here, I’ve been experimenting with AI 3D generators recently. While they are great for rapid prototyping, the generated mesh topology and UVs are usually a complete mess for production or game engines.

Retopologizing is quick, but manual texture re-baking was taking up way too much time. So I created a free 3ds Max script called **ai2tex** to automate the baking pipeline.

**How it works for AI 3D pipelines:**

* **Automated Baking:** Projects and bakes diffuse textures from dense, raw AI models (FBX/OBJ with Physical Material) straight onto your clean low-poly retopo mesh.
* **One-Click Workflow:** No tedious manual Projection modifier setups.
* **Saves Time:** Cuts the retopo-to-shading step from minutes to just a few seconds.

*Check out the comparison in the image attached! Free download link and YouTube video demo are in the comments below.*

Thanks for checking it out!
